item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S.-Iran Peace Deal Nearer, But Could Take Days to Nail Down, U.S. Official Says
item.description: The official said the sides had agreed in principle to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and commit Iran to disposing of its highly enriched uranium, but stressed that a deal had not yet been signed.

item.title: What to Know About the Potential U.S.-Iran Peace Deal
item.description: President Trump said on Saturday that an agreement to end the war was “largely negotiated,” but neither the United States nor Iran released many details of the proposal.

item.title: Middle East war live: Trump says US will not ‘rush into a deal’ to end Iran war
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Sunday said he had told US representatives not to rush into a deal with Iran, calling for both sides to “take their time and get it right”. Trump said the US blockade on Iran’s ports would remain in place until a deal was reached. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Israeli Leader Says He and Trump Agree On Blocking an Iranian Nuclear Weapon
item.description: Analysts said Israel was worried that a potential agreement would not significantly degrade Iran’s nuclear and missile capabilities.

item.title: Fate of War in Lebanon Rests Mostly With Outside Powers
item.description: A U.S.-Iran peace deal could calm the conflict in Lebanon between Israel and Hezbollah. But that will depend mainly on what the United States, Iran and Israel decide.

item.title: Senate Republicans Cast Doubt on a Potential Peace Deal With Iran
item.description: Lawmakers, including some of President Trump’s closest allies, slammed the emerging agreement as effectively undermining the president’s own war goals.

item.title: 'Bibi's hair on fire': Trump-Netanyahu public 'rift' masked unified front against Iran, analyst says
item.description: Leading defense analyst says Trump-Netanyahu tensions over Iran were a calculated strategy to blindside Tehran while building a unified front.

item.title: These Are 5 of the Main Issues to Be Resolved in an Iran-U.S. Peace Deal
item.description: President Trump says the U.S. and Iran could be close to a peace deal. The big issues at stake include the fate of Iran’s nuclear program and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Rubio Says Details on Iran Nuclear Program Still to Be Negotiated
item.description: The Secretary of State said the United States was prepared to begin those talks if Iran opens the Strait of Hormuz as part of an apparently emerging deal on the war.

item.title: Mass tanker blackout rattles Gulf ahead of 1.35M-barrel oil transfer amid US-Iran talks: firm
item.description: Maritime tracking signals collapse near the UAE's Fujairah oil hub hours before President Trump announced progress on a bilateral peace deal with Iran, according to an AI maritime firm.
